ValidationRule.description: Process Assessment Code should contain "Cancelled" before a case can be cancelled.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'SCON Onboarding', ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Cancelled'), NOT(CONTAINS(TEXT(Process_Assessment__c), 'Cancelled'))
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Process Assessment should contain "Cancelled" before a case can be cancelled.
